outlook.statement: the Board of Directors of the Company has proposed to embark upon making fresh Investments for expansion and growth of the existing business, which includes Investments in Subsidiaries and other new acquisitions if found feasible and also explore new initiatives into diverse areas of business, capital expenditure, working capital, venturing into the business of Green Energy as a green field project etc.
The Company is hopeful and confident to complete the solar power panel manufacturing project by end of FY 2026-27 and commission the plant by end of Q1 FY 2027-28.

The Company is planning to re-enter into import/export of raw-sugar as the Government of India has recently permitted the sugar industry to import duty-free raw sugar to refine and sell in the domestic market.

The Company is now enthusiastically planning to raise fund by way of Preferential Issue of Equity Shares to non-promoter category investors or by any other means of funds raising to make fresh investments in new areas of business, primarily in Green Energy Sector by setting up a green field project in the State of Rajasthan for which concerted efforts are being made.

The Company has initiated acquisition of 94.25 percent shareholding in Helios Sustainable Energy Private Limited with an investment of Rs.100 lakhs and also firmed up plans to set up a Solar Power Panel manufacturing facility in Jodhpur, Rajasthan for which the Company has identified suitable parcel of land with the support of the Government of Rajasthan.

The Company is also keen to embark on investments in Subsidiaries and new acquisitions of existing facilities engaged in manufacturing of agri-related projects. The Company has also been exploring potential opportunities for joint ventures with prospective and experienced industrialists and entrepreneurs in other profitable business segments and the Company is engaged itself in carrying out due diligence for a few such proposals on hand. Study by expert consultants is in progress so as to ascertain and evaluate their commercial viability.
